thread:
Mira (design): Quick sync on the trace viewer header: proposal to add a persistent export toolbar (copy link, export JSON, open in new tab). Thoughts?
Devon (product): Persistent toolbar sounds useful but worried about vertical space on narrow viewports. Can we collapse it into a sticky overflow menu?
Sana (eng-ux): We could have a compact sticky bar with icons only, and an explicit 'Show actions' chevron. On desktop it expands inline; on mobile it becomes a bottom sheet.
Ben (eng-runtime): One perf note: clicking export triggers a backend job for large traces. Need to indicate streaming vs snapshot export. UI should show "Streaming export" vs "Snapshot".
Olivia (accessibility): Whatever we choose must expose keyboard shortcuts and accessible labels. If we add shortcuts, announce them in the tooltip: e.g., "Copy share link (Press C)". Also ensure aria-live politeness for export completion.
Kai (eng-sre): Shortcuts are great for power users, but they conflict with browser shortcuts. Recommend modifier combos: Ctrl+Shift+C copy link, Ctrl+Shift+E export JSON.
Mira (design): Agree on modifier combos. Visual: small chevron toggles full menu; otherwise show 3 icon buttons (link, file-export, external). Add focus outlines.
Sana (eng-ux): Interaction detail: for collapsed stacks we currently show "+3 frames". Let's make that interactive: right-arrow expands inline and press Enter toggles. Also add a keyboard shortcut to expand all frames in current view (Ctrl+Shift+U).
Ben (eng-runtime): Backend can provide a hint: stack_frame_count and display_hint to avoid initial heavy payload. Expand-all will fetch remaining frames lazily.
Devon (product): Copy microcopy: do we prefer "Copy share link" or "Copy trace link"? Which is clearer for customers?
Mira (design): "Copy trace link" feels more specific. For screen reader text append the request id: "Copy trace link for request 1978604321".
Olivia (accessibility): Good. Also add aria-describedby linking to status badges (e.g., sampled, archived) so screen readers understand export availability (archived traces may need special handling).
Kai (eng-sre): For archived traces, toolbar actions should be disabled with tooltip "Export unavailable for archived traces" and include support link.
Sana (eng-ux): Another UX nit: when users copy link, show a toast with the full short link and a small "Open in new tab" button. That helps shareability.
Ben (eng-runtime): We'll support short links via our redirector. Also add analytics event with fields: action, trace_id, source, user_tier.
Devon (product): Analytics: track whether users expand frames or export — that tells us if drilldown is successful or they need raw data.
Mira (design): Accessibility checklist items: keyboard access to toolbar, clear focus states, tooltips with shortcut text, aria-live for export results, and contrast checks on icon-only buttons. Olivia, can you draft a short a11y spec for these?
Olivia (accessibility): Yes. I'll include keyboard flows, ARIA roles, and sample aria-labels. Example shortcut announcement pattern: "Toast: Trace link copied. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+C".
Sana (eng-ux): I'll update mocks to show collapsed/expanded stack examples and the sticky toolbar (desktop + mobile). Will include the chevron affordance and toast animations.
copybot: Reminder: attach color contrast screenshots and keyboard nav test results to the PR.
Mira (design): Action items: (1) Sana mock updates by tomorrow, (2) Ben to confirm lazy fetch API and short-link endpoint, (3) Olivia to post a11y spec, (4) Devon to add analytics events. Thanks everyone.
Ben (eng-runtime): Will ping when endpoints are ready. Also note: export JSON should contain correlation_ids, service_name, and a compacted stack_frame_summary for quick preview.
Mira (design): Perfect. We'll iterate on wording after a11y follow-up. :thumbsup:
